data.title: Gas price increase effective 1 January 2027
data.summary: Erdgas Beispieltal GmbH informs Johanna Beispielacker that gas prices will rise from 1 January 2027: the unit price goes from 9.84 to 11.12 ct/kWh and the monthly advance payment (Abschlag) rises from €104.00 to €118.00.
data.explanation: Your gas supplier is raising its price per kWh and your monthly advance payment (Abschlag) starting 1 January 2027. Because of this price increase, you have a special right to cancel the contract (Sonderkündigungsrecht) without the usual notice period, but your cancellation must reach the supplier before the new price takes effect — the app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the new price and advance payment apply automatically from 1 January 2027. Review whether the new price is still reasonable and consider comparing other providers before deciding.
